verdict.rationale: Folk documents self-serve ways to bring in real data: automatic Google contacts import and sync, Gmail conversation sync, one-click LinkedIn imports, and list import via MCP. Pipeline management is listed as a plan feature, so the building blocks of a quick, self-run setup are first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows the speed of onboarding or that no implementation help is needed. Missing for 10: evidence of time-to-value under an hour, a documented guided onboarding or pipeline setup flow, a CSV/CRM migration path, and independent hands-on reports confirming setup without a partner.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Automatically import and sync your Google contacts with folk
